description: The competitive tier's corpus set (docs/competitive/DESIGN.md s3.4): the three pinned by benchmarks/tasks.json stay for continuity with every published jcm number; the five additional ones are where the set is expected to lose. Every corpus is a checkout at a full commit SHA; the SHA was recorded before any tool ran on it (2026-09-06). The self corpus (this tree's src/) is added by run.py at the running commit and is not listed here.
cache: Checkouts live OUTSIDE the tree (corpora.py: $JCM_COMPETE_CORPORA or ~/.cache/jcm-compete/corpora) because benchmarks/ ships in the sdist and a checked-out corpus under it would ship too.

corpora.description: FastAPI, Python async web framework (benchmarks/tasks.json pin)
Gin, Go HTTP web framework (benchmarks/tasks.json pin)
lodash 4.17.21, a single 17k-line UMD file plus fp/ helpers; sverklo-bench's corpus, its tasks apply as written

NestJS 12.0.0, a TypeScript monorepo of 2,301 tracked files (1,821 .ts): the 2,000-5,000-file TypeScript bucket, chosen by corpus_check's criteria on 2026-09-06

Angular 22.1.5, 10,527 tracked files (5,988 .ts): a second over-10,000-file corpus, added on 2026-09-06 because one alone puts its language over corpus_policy's 60% cap (corpus_check (e)); with it Java and TypeScript each stay under the cap
